subject: Insurance
title: Total Loss: When Your Car Is Gone
description: A quick win: understand Total Loss: When Your Car Is Gone.

hook.text: If repair costs exceed 70-80% of your car's value.

buildup.text: The market value is based on comparable recent sales.

discovery.text: You can negotiate the total loss valuation.

twist.text: Many owners are underwater—they owe more than the car is worth.

climax.text: A total loss forces a financial reckoning. Your car's insured value is almost never what you think it should be.

quiz.question: When does an insurer declare a car a total loss?
options: When repair costs exceed 70-80% of the car's market value
When the car is older than 10 years
